description: Check up to 10 packages from one ecosystem in one call, e.g. a project's dependency list, and get the same status, verdict and evidence for each. Flags deprecated, archived and stale dependencies.

ecosystem.description: Package ecosystem: pypi, npm, cargo, go, maven, nuget or rubygems (aliases like python, node, rust, java accepted).

name: check_packages
title: Check a list of dependencies
